manual_read: Installed manual pp194-195 gives implicit default-profile identities, centered cycles and 50h remainder scaling; p194 comparison text conflicts with worked examples, so this review uses native events.
limits: One deployed aircraft in one explicit unit; no multi-type interaction or explicit-profile suppression control.
Generated default mission log has success/completion events, while ResultSummary MSTF/MSUF remain zero; the report supports MTMF/STMF=1 only for those summary fields.
GUI Profile View rendering and cross-engine parity were not tested.
